package.name: go2_brain
package.description:
Phase 5 autonomy stub. A single node (stub_brain) that closes the social-nav loop: it consumes perception and the robot's /odom, runs a basic Social Force Model, and publishes /cmd_vel at 20 Hz. It REPLACES teleop as the /cmd_vel producer and is a deliberately simple placeholder that the IT2-FLS controller (Phase 7) will later swap in for at the exact same interface.
Phase 12: its control maths now reads the canonical `Track` contract, not people_msgs. The /people subscription remains, but the message is converted at the boundary by `people_oracle` and the People type never reaches the control loop — so this node, and its IT2-FLS successor, run unchanged against ground truth or against real LiDAR+camera fusion.
